title: Scourge of the Heavenly Way
next_chapter_hook: Just as the five factions believed victory was within reach, Chen Ji threw his head back in laughter, the sound shaking the nine heavens. There was not a trace of fear in that laughter—only the madness and resolve compressed for a thousand years. 'A five-way game? Perfect. I'm going to flip the table!'

text.content: Within the celestial rift, three distinctly different pressures tangled, collided, and probed each other. Cang Yutian's noble righteous aura blazed like the midday sun, forcibly suppressing the demonic commander's killing intent by three parts; the Netherworld Force of the Demonic Holy Sect condensed into tangible black tides on the other side; and deeper still, countless faintly discernible gazes peered from the void at all this—those were the tentacles of the Heavenly Way's residual will, ancient, ice-cold, transcending life and death. Chen Ji stood at the center of these three forces, his robes battered by the intertwining gusts, his face devoid of any expression, only a nearly-mad计算的光芒 burning deep in his eyes.

At that moment, a low sigh echoed from the depths of the void. The voice came from no specific direction—it seemed to ring from all sides simultaneously, as if sounding directly within everyone's Mental Sea. 'Why bother?' The voice was ancient enough to have witnessed trillions of years of time's passage. 'Regardless of who wins or loses among you, in the end you are merely chess pieces on the board. And the true chess player never needs to stand on stage.' Before the words finished, the void began to distort, and an enormous eye瞳—impossible to describe in language—slowly opened in the depths of the rift. It was the Heavenly Eye's residual will, manifesting in its ultimate form.

dialogue.content: Chen Ji. The voice called his name directly, without a trace of emotional波动. 'You think you are arranging the world beneath heaven, but you fail to realize that from the very day you picked up that turtle shell, every choice you made, every move you played, every opponent and ally you had—all were calculated. The Tianji Record is a chess piece this One placed in the world, and you... you are merely a tool in that piece's hand.'

text.content: Within the Heavenly Eye's pupil, countless images circulated—Chen Ji's entire life, from the moment his prophetic power was discovered in childhood, through his ten years of enduring humiliation at Tianqing Sect, to this moment standing between the five factions. Each frame was agonizingly clear, every detail rendered in meticulous detail. 'Your father Chen Xuan was also a chess piece of This One.' The voice continued,带上某种讽刺的意味. 'He tried to resist, so he died under heavenly fate's backlash. And you inherited his fragment, and his destiny as well—no matter what you choose, it will ultimately lead to the same ending.'

dialogue.content: Is that so? Chen Ji finally spoke, his voice平静得像深潭死水. His hand slowly reached into his怀,取出那枚跟随他多年的龟壳—父亲留下的唯一遗物. The turtle shell's surface was now emanating a faint glow, as if sensing some kind of召唤. 'Then I would like to ask, venerable one—if you can calculate everything about me, why did you personally appear?' He raised his head,直视那双横亘虚空的巨瞳,嘴角勾起一丝讥讽的弧度. 'Could it be that you fear this chess piece suddenly doesn't want to follow the script?'

text.content: The Heavenly Eye's pupil contracted slightly. 'Because you possess something This One cannot predict.' The voice carried a rare hint of apprehension. 'That turtle shell—you thought it was merely a普通的预言道具? No, it is a fragment of the Axis of Fate. In ancient times, This One scattered the Tianji Record throughout the world, and one fragment was deliberately sealed by This One because it carried too much 'possibility.' Your father discovered its secret and wanted to use it to break This One's control. In the end, he died for his ambition. And you—using such a short time, you have actually awakened it initially.'

Chen Ji lowered his gaze to the turtle shell in his hand, his眼神变得复杂. This object that had accompanied him for years—he had always thought it was merely a psychological keepsake of his father, never imagining it concealed such earth-shattering secrets. Fine, dense patterns now surfaced on the turtle shell's surface, those patterns slowly flowing, as if some living thing breathed within. He could feel a warm force surging from the turtle shell, creating some kind of resonance with the Tianji Record fragment in his body—that was the awakening of the Axis of Fate fragment, responding to his every choice over the years.

dialogue.content: Now you have two choices. The Heavenly Eye's voice恢复了冰冷. 'First: surrender the Axis of Fate fragment and return to the trajectory This One has set. This One can promise to let you and those you care about safely leave this chess game. You may continue being your talentless disciple until your lifespan exhausts itself. Second: continue resisting. But This One must tell you—the lives of everyone around you, your missing sister Chen Nian, Su Qingyao—the only one you trust at Tianqing Sect, your ally Ye Qing in the demonic path, even the guardian's remnant soul within you—their life and death hinge entirely on your single thought.'

text.content: Before the words finished, several light curtains emerged in the void. Within them, Chen Nian's clear view as she was imprisoned by chains in the depths of Holy Sect was visible; Su Qingyao facing Ling Yuan's pressure alone, blood at the corner of her mouth yet still stubbornly straightening her spine; Ye Qing trapped within the Demonic Holy Sect's restraints, fellow sect members judging her; and deep within the Tianji Record fragment, Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul was being剥离一点 by some force, its light growing dimmer by the moment. Every face, every scene in those light curtains were people Chen Ji cared about most.

dialogue.content: Do you see?' The Heavenly Eye's voice carried cruel satisfaction. 'This is the price of your resistance. This One watches every move you make. This One knows every one of your weaknesses. And your so-called 'arranging the world beneath heaven'—in This One's eyes it is merely a joke—because the arranger himself is the most important chess piece on This One's board. The moment you try to jump off the board is the moment everyone you care about turns to dust.'

text.content: All three factions held their breath at this moment. Cang Yutian frowned tightly,他能感受到天道之眼残余意志的强大—那是超越了他们所有人认知的存在. The demonic commander's expression was grimly terrible,显然也没想到这场博弈中还有第六方势力介入. And in the Tianqing Sect direction, Ling Yuan's figure flickered in and out of the clouds, his eyes filled with complex brilliance,似乎在思考着什么. Chen Ji was being watched by all five factions simultaneously, the pressure of choice reaching an unprecedented peak.

choice.prompt: Facing the Heavenly Eye's threat and two options, what choice should Chen Ji make?

choices.description: First ensure the safety of those you care about, feign compliance with heaven's arrangement, secretly seek a method to break the局. Retreat to advance, wait for the right moment.
choices.visible_cost: Lose control of the Axis of Fate fragment, may永远 be manipulated by heaven
choices.visible_reward: Buy precious time for sister, Su Qingyao, Ye Qing, Mo Xiansheng
choices.risk_hint: Heaven will not give you much time, and once you compromise, your fortune will gradually dissipate

text.content: Chen Ji remained silent for a moment, his fingers gently stroking the turtle shell. He was calculating—calculating how much time compliance could buy him, calculating the blind spots in heaven's surveillance, calculating the survival probability of those he cared about. This was not cowardice, this was蛰伏. His gaze gradually deepened,嘴角勾起一丝不易察觉的冷笑. 'Very well.' He spoke, his voice平静. 'I can surrender the Axis of Fate fragment. But I have conditions—the safety of each and every one of them, you must guarantee with a heavenly oath.'

choices.description: Refuse heaven's threat on the spot, use the Axis of Fate fragment's power to对抗 heaven's residual will, wager everything.
choices.visible_cost: Sister, Chen Nian, Mo Xiansheng and others may be instantly erased by heaven
choices.visible_reward: Possibility to break heaven's chess game, let heaven know you are not a chess piece to be arranged
choices.risk_hint: Success probability extremely low, may lead to complete defeat, but if successful the收益 are enormous

text.content: Chen Ji's gaze suddenly turned as sharp as a blade. He tightly gripped the Turtle Shell, and the imperfect Tianji Record within his body surged wildly, his ability to foresee the future automatically activating—but this time, what he saw was not the scene three hours later, but a chaotic Void. Within that Void, the patterns of the Fate Axis fragment intertwined with the light of the Tianji Record Fragment, forming a power capable of tearing apart heaven and earth. "Fuck heaven's will," he chuckled lowly, his smile carrying years of suppressed madness, "I, Chen Ji, have never been anyone's pawn—I am the one who moves the pieces!"

choices.description: Exploit the opposition between the three factions and heaven's will remnants, muddy the waters, find a breakthrough point in the chaos, and use external forces to escape.
choices.visible_cost: Requires sacrificing some layout pieces, and may be countered by the three factions' backlash
choices.visible_reward: Break the siege of five factions, forcing heaven's will and the Fate Writer to officially oppose each other
choices.risk_hint: The three factions each have their own calculations and may not act according to your plan

text.content: Chen Ji suddenly smiled, that expression appearing especially eerie in the tense atmosphere. He raised his head, his gaze sweeping across all the present factions—Cang Yutian's righteous aura, the demonic path commander-in-chief's abyssal black tide, Ling Yuan's silhouette within the clouds, and the Heaven's Eye's massive pupil spanning the Void. "Interesting," his voice wasn't loud, yet it clearly reached everyone's ears, "You all want me, all want to use me, but have any of you considered—if I choose to stand against all of you?" He lightly flicked the Turtle Shell, producing a crisp sound, "The Fate Axis fragment has been preliminarily awakened by me. Now, it answers to me."

Just as Chen Ji's words fell, the patterns on the Turtle Shell's surface suddenly began剧烈跳动起来. Those originally slowly flowing lines were now activated by some force, starting to rotate, interweave, and reorganize following a bizarre pattern. A majestic power of fate erupted from the Turtle Shell, forming a pale golden aura around Chen Ji. Though faint, that aura made the Heaven's Eye's pupil sharply contract—for it was a power fluctuation unique to the Fate Axis, a forbidden force capable of shaking heaven's foundations.

dialogue.content: "Impossible!" The Heaven's Eye's voice showed fluctuation for the first time, that ancient will clearly not having anticipated Chen Ji would activate the Fate Axis fragment under such circumstances, "You clearly haven't fully mastered it—" Before the words finished, another voice suddenly echoed from the Void, that voice aged and familiar, carrying a certain transcendent indifference. "Because he is not a chess piece you designed, but an heir I have chosen." With the voice, a phantom figure slowly emerged from the depths of the Turtle Shell—it was Mo Xiansheng, manifesting in physical form as a remnant soul, "The struggle between the Fate Writer and heaven's will has lasted for trillions of years. And today, this stalemate shall finally be broken."

text.content: Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul was even more translucent than before, nearly transparent as if it might dissipate at any moment. But his gaze remained sharp as a blade, sweeping across all present factions—the Heaven's Eye, the Three Sects, the Demonic Path, the Tianqing Sect—each time his gaze passed over them, those self-proclaimed powerful beings couldn't help but tense their nerves. "Heaven's Eye, did you think you had won?" Mo Xiansheng coldly laughed, "All the chess pieces you positioned in the world—every fragment of the Tianji Record, every prophet, every segment of history—are merely ripples in the river of fate. And true fate has never been within your control."

The Heaven's Eye and the Fate Writer's remnant will officially confronted each other in the Void. Chen Ji stood between the two, feeling two forces beyond his comprehension battling for control around him. A voice rang in his mind—it was Mo Xiansheng, a secret transmission directly to his soul: "Chen Ji, my time is running out. Before heaven discovers my true intentions, I must tell you something—the Turtle Shell your father left is not only a fragment of the Fate Axis, it is also a key. A key to open the 'Origin Land.' The secrets hidden there are enough to overturn the balance between heaven's will and the Fate Writer for ten thousand years. But the path there is open only to you—because you are Chen Xuan's son, your bloodline carries the key to that door."

The leaders of the three factions all sensed the situation spiraling out of control. Cang Yutian's brow furrowed tightly; he hadn't expected there to be deeper waters in this game—the ten-thousand-year struggle between heaven's will and the Fate Writer, a secret not even recorded in ancient texts. The demonic path commander-in-chief's eyes flickered with greed; the words "Origin Land" clearly touched a deep nerve within him. And Ling Yuan's figure in the clouds grew even more indistinct, seemingly rapidly approaching—he was the former Sect Master of Tianqing Sect, Chen Xuan's previous generational inheritor candidate, and regarding the secrets of the "Origin Land," he clearly possessed extraordinary knowledge.

choice.prompt: Mo Xiansheng revealed the secrets of the Origin Land, now Chen Ji needs to make a choice:

choices.description: In the chaos, question Mo Xiansheng about specific information regarding the Origin Land, even if only a few seconds, to obtain as much intelligence as possible.
choices.visible_cost: May expose key information you possess, potentially drawing more factions' covetousness
choices.visible_reward: Gain crucial clues about the Origin Land, adding leverage for subsequent schemes
choices.risk_hint: Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul may dissipate at any moment, with extremely limited time for questioning

dialogue.content: Chen Ji sent an inquiring signal to Mo Xiansheng through his gaze. Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul slightly nodded, his voice ringing directly in Chen Ji's Mental Sea: "The Origin Land lies in the deepest part of the Heavenly Realm, the place where heaven's will and fate were born together. To reach there, you must gather three things—all the fragments of the Tianji Record, the complete awakening of the Fate Axis fragment, and 'Chen Xuan's Testament Letter.' You already have clues to the latter two; the first one... you know better than me where to find it." Before the words finished, Mo Xiansheng's figure had already begun dissipating, "Remember, trust no promises given by heaven's will—every word it speaks is a trap."

choices.description: Exploit the three factions' greed and the Heaven's Eye's wariness to create greater chaos, buying yourself an opportunity to escape.
choices.visible_cost: May provoke the Heaven's Eye, causing it to act desperately regardless of consequences
choices.visible_reward: Shift everyone's attention in the chaos, creating space for subsequent actions
choices.risk_hint: Requires precise control of the situation in extremely limited time, with extremely low error tolerance

text.content: Chen Ji took a deep breath and made a move unexpected by everyone—he raised the Turtle Shell high, letting the light of the Fate Axis fragment bloom in the Void. "Everyone!" His voice resounded through the entire Heavenly Realm fissure, "Isn't this what you all want? The Fate Axis fragment, the key to the Origin Land! Who dares to claim it?" This shout instantly broke the deadlock. Cang Yutian's expression changed, the demonic path commander-in-chief's killing intent surged, Ling Yuan's figure burst forth from the clouds—and the Heaven's Eye let out an angry roar. Five factions moved simultaneously.

"The moment the five powers simultaneously lunged toward Chen Ji, the Eye of Heavenly Dao let out a furious roar. 'Enough!' The pressure contained in that voice shook the hearts of everyone present. 'You insects actually think you can snatch someone before me?' The moment the words fell, an invisible binding force descended from the heavens, enveloping the entire Heavenly Realm rift. The leaders of the five powers all felt the terror of this force at the same time—it was the manifestation of Heavenly Dao's laws, an existence beyond everything. Cang Yutian's righteous aura was suppressed, the Demonic Path commander-in-chief's netherworldly black tide was frozen, and even Ling Yuan's figure, which was about to reach Chen Ji, was fixed motionless in mid-air."

Chen Ji became the only one who could still move. The Eye of Heavenly Dao's enormous pupil stared intently at him, the images flowing within it no longer a threat, but a complex calculation. 'You think you've won?' That voice carried sarcasm. 'You've merely transferred from my chessboard to the chessboard of those who write fate. Mo Xiansheng chose you, not because you're special, but because you're the son of Chen Xuan—your bloodline carries the variable I despise most. I cannot kill you directly, but I can make everyone you care about watch you walk toward destruction in despair.'

However, Chen Ji's heart was unusually calm at this moment. He looked at everything bound around him, at the Eye of Heavenly Dao's arrogance spanning the void, at the shock and unwillingness on the faces of the five powers' leaders, and remembered all the schemes, humiliations, and calculations over these years. The turtle shell in his palm grew slightly warm, and the power of the Fate Axis fragment was resonating with his soul in some way. He saw some blurry images—those were possibilities of the future, a future that even the Eye of Heavenly Dao couldn't fully predict. In that future, there was Chen Nian's smile of rescue, Su Qingyao's silhouette standing shoulder to shoulder with him, Ye Qing's relief of gaining freedom, and Mo Xiansheng's relieved smile before completely dissipating. And the starting point of that future was right now.

choice.prompt: The five powers were bound, the Eye of Heavenly Dao thought victory was assured—how would Chen Ji break the deadlock?

choices.description: Release all the power accumulated in the Fate Axis fragment at once, breaking the Heavenly Dao's binding through destructive means.
choices.visible_cost: The turtle shell may be completely destroyed, will consume a large amount of Heavenly Fate, and the body will suffer extreme backlash
choices.visible_reward: Break the Heavenly Dao's binding, restore freedom to the five powers, and seek escape opportunities in the chaos
choices.risk_hint: The turtle shell is his father's legacy and an important trump card—once destroyed, this advantage will be lost

text.content: Chen Ji slowly closed his eyes, pouring all his spiritual awareness into the turtle shell in his palm. The power of the Fate Axis fragment was completely activated at this moment, dense patterns emerging on the turtle shell's surface. Those patterns were spreading, growing, and blooming at an incredible speed—ultimately transforming into a golden pillar of light sufficient to tear apart the heavens. 'You want me to die?' Chen Ji opened his eyes, madness burning in his pupils. 'Then let me show you what it means to find life through death!' The pillar of light shot upward, directly colliding with the Eye of Heavenly Dao's binding force. With a thunderous boom, the heavens and earth changed color.

choices.description: Proactively engage in dialogue with the Eye of Heavenly Dao, proposing a deal it cannot refuse, trading benefits for a breathing space.
choices.visible_cost: May require paying a heavy price, and will owe a favor to Heavenly Dao
choices.visible_reward: Gain precious time and space, creating conditions for subsequent arrangements
choices.risk_hint: Heavenly Dao never makes a losing deal—the negotiation result may be extremely unfavorable to Chen Ji

dialogue.content: Chen Ji suddenly withdrew all his power, the turtle shell's glow gradually fading. He raised his head, directly facing the Eye of Heavenly Dao's enormous pupil, a meaningful smile curling at the corner of his mouth. 'You're right, I am indeed a chess piece.' His voice was unusually calm. 'But have you ever considered that even chess pieces have value? I can help you collect all the fragments of the Tianji Record. The secrets of the Origin Land, I can share with you as well. But I have one condition—I want you to release them first.' His finger pointed to the bound five powers. 'With them around, you can never truly control me. But if we cooperate... I can become your sharpest blade.'

text.content: The moment Chen Ji's words fell, the entire Heavenly Realm rift fell into an eerie silence. The Eye of Heavenly Dao's pupil turned slightly, seemingly examining this human who was no bigger than an insect. It had lived for trillions of years, seen countless chess pieces attempt rebellion, but never had any single piece dared to propose conditions so calmly before it. 'You're interesting.' Its voice carried something resembling appreciation for the first time. 'But you think you have the qualification to negotiate with me?' Before the words finished,耀眼的光芒突然从天道之眼的瞳孔中爆发，一道蕴含天道法则的力量直接轰向陈机的神魂——它要强行抹去他的意识，将他变成一个没有自我意志的傀儡。

However, the moment that force was about to touch Chen Ji, the turtle shell in his palm suddenly erupted with dazzling golden light—that was the instinctive protective mechanism of the Fate Axis fragment. Two forces beyond the mortal realm collided violently in mid-air, creating visible ripples that shattered the surrounding binding force. Cang Yutian, the Demonic Path commander-in-chief, and Ling Yuan simultaneously regained their ability to move, while Chen Ji groaned from the backlash of this strike, blood seeping from the corner of his mouth. But there was not a trace of fear in his eyes—instead, they flickered with a kind of madness—because he knew that at this moment, he had finally broken the Heavenly Dao's chess game.

The Eye of Heavenly Dao let out a furious roar, the anger in that voice sufficient to shatter the souls of ordinary cultivators. But Chen Ji had no time to care about its anger, because at this moment, Mo Xiansheng's final voice rang out in his mind—that voice was as weak as if it would dissipate in the wind at any moment, yet carried a kind of relieved calm: 'Chen Ji, the last thing I can do for you is use my remnant soul power to help you break this layer of binding. Now... it's time to let everyone see your true face. The act of废物 Chen Ji, performed for ten years, should end.' The words fell, Mo Xiansheng's figure completely dissipated into the void. And at that moment, Chen Ji felt something open within his body—that was a memory sealed deep within the Tianji Record fragments, about the true cause of his father Chen Xuan's death, and also about the ultimate truth of his own destiny.

Chen Ji slowly raised his head, wiping away the blood at the corner of his mouth, looking around. Cang Yutian, the Demonic Path commander-in-chief, Ling Yuan—the leaders of the three powers all looked at him now, their eyes carrying unprecedented wariness. The residual will of the Eye of Heavenly Dao still hung in the void above, though dimmed by the earlier impact, still radiating an oppressive pressure. Five-way game, turned into chaos. And he, Chen Ji, stood at the very center of this storm, feeling the pleasure of fate's gears finally beginning to turn. He thought of all the忍辱, schemes, and calculations over these years, of the Heavenly Fate consumed each time the Tianji Record provided foresight, of the dead, the living, the people he cared about—all the sacrifices, all the planning, all for this moment.

Just as everyone thought Chen Ji would take the opportunity to escape or form an alliance with one of the powers, he suddenly threw his head back and laughed wildly. That laughter echoed through the silent Heavenly Realm rift, carrying a madness and unrestrained nature that had been suppressed for a millennium finally released. The laughter grew louder, more unbridled, until even the surrounding clouds trembled. Cang Yutian furrowed his brow, the Demonic Path commander-in-chief's expression turned grimly dark, Ling Yuan's eyes flashed with disbelief—and the Eye of Heavenly Dao's pupil contracted sharply, as if sensing something ominous about to happen. Chen Ji stopped laughing, his gaze sharp as a blade, staring directly at the Eye of Heavenly Dao. 'Five-way game?' His voice was clear and wild. 'Perfect—I want to flip the table!'
